changelog:
Initial release of the "write-viral-fiction-hooks" skill.

- Generates five distinct types of viral Chinese short-fiction opening hooks from a user-provided scene idea.
- Supports selectable, clearly labeled hook options, each with a concise Chinese intro and a one-line hook explanation.
- After selection, produces a final micro-fiction copy under 200 Chinese characters.
- Adapts tone and structure based on genre, relationship, and conflict clues in the provided scene.
- Follows strict output formatting and style rules to maximize reader engagement and virality.
